title: Story material
description: Creative material that has not yet found its place in the story (conventions §12): intentions, unplaced scenes, obligations, gaps, maybes. The first rung of the ladder — material, proposed, canon, manuscript. Never load-bearing for prose; vagueness is the point.

body.description: The material itself, as vague as it honestly is

purpose.description: What this would do for the story

related.description: Canon ids this touches — the only validated linkage

window.description: The chapter range where this likely belongs, when known

satisfied_by.description: What discharges this requirement (conventions §12): material, scene, or canon ids. Absence is the normal state of an open obligation — the reports read it, not the author.

placed_in.description: Where it landed, once placed (chapter or scene id)
